findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_material_detail_v2, submit_reference_image_search · Private data: get_store_game_rank, get_store_game_rank_trend, get_game_materials, resolve_game_by_identifier, report_capability_gap · Public sink: submit_reference_image_search · Destructive: submit_reference_image_search, search_materials_by_filter, get_game_ads_v2.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_material_detail_v2, submit_reference_image_search · Private data: get_store_game_rank, get_store_game_rank_trend, get_game_materials, resolve_game_by_identifier, report_capability_gap · Public sink: submit_reference_image_search · Destructive: submit_reference_image_search, search_materials_by_filter, get_game_ads_v2

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
